task_role: calibration tasks; excluded from subsequent formal experiments
config: DYNAMICDAG node-level: e1=large, e2=large, r=medium, v=coder

cache_identity.model_binding: resolved model name via bindings dict (e.g., 'medium'→'Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct')
cache_identity.prompt_sha256: sha256 of complete prompt text (includes upstream dependency values)
cache_identity.node_name: key.split(':')[3], the logical node within the DAG
cache_identity.scope: the run scope string; SHARED across all scenarios in this validation
cache_identity.cross_state_rule: scope is validation-wide (includes clean AND fault scenarios); this is by design because fault injection replaces the answer AFTER the call, so the underlying (model, prompt) execution is state-independent; the INJECTED answer is never cached (smoke_runner line 117-120: fault branch returns before cache write)
cache_identity.S4_guarantee: S4 uses identical scope + task + node + model + prompt as S1 → full identity match → guaranteed cache hit

reserved_for_S3_FULL.reservation_rule: if global requests reach 22 before S3 starts, skip remaining S2 tasks to ensure at least 1 complete S3 task
reserved_for_S3_FULL.if_not_met: log FULL_UNVERIFIED; do not claim FULL mechanism validated

budget.budget_counter: single global, persisted to disk, no reset

order_rationale: interleave S2/S3 after S4 to ensure at least one complete S3 before budget risk; S3_task1 is guaranteed by reservation

must_complete: S3 (≥1 complete task with all 4 nodes traversing FULL path)
minimum_completion.if_S3_not_completed: status = FULL_UNVERIFIED; S1/S4/S2 evidence retained separately

S1_no_recovery.new_requests: ≤4 per task (cold); some may hit cross-task cache if prompts identical

S4_cache_reuse.new_requests: 0 per task (all must hit S1 cache — if any new request, this is an UNEXPECTED_PATTERN stop)
S4_cache_reuse.acceptance: all 4 calls per task have alias_of pointing to S1 events

S2_local_reroute.new_requests: 1-3 (e1/e2/v-planned cached from S1; r_esc + v_fbd new)
S2_local_reroute.injection_note: injection replaces answer AFTER call; no extra request; billed at clean-ref cost

S3_full_replay.purpose: verify FULL: all 4 nodes traverse full logical re-execution path
S3_full_replay.new_requests: 0-4 per task depending on cache overlap; acceptance requires LOGICAL path traversal, not new requests
S3_full_replay.acceptance: all 4 nodes appear in replay execution log with cache_hits or new_requests correctly attributed; billing separation complete

latency_calibration.serial_reconstruction: sum of individual latency_s from MeteredExecutor; this IS the L optimization target
latency_calibration.wall_clock: time.monotonic first-to-last per task; DIAGNOSTIC ONLY (includes queueing)
latency_calibration.calibration_from_S1: new_L_max = max(S1 serial reconstruction) * 1.4; frozen BEFORE S2/S3; version-tagged
latency_calibration.S2_S3_out_of_range: values exceeding frozen L scale reported as out_of_range count; NOT used to recalibrate; clipped values used for HV but real values preserved in log
latency_calibration.no_real_latency_claim: L objective is serial service-demand reconstruction; no claim of real E2E deployment latency advantage

stopping_rules.budget_exhaustion: stop; log completed vs pending; if S3 min not met → FULL_UNVERIFIED
stopping_rules.S4_new_request: UNEXPECTED_PATTERN stop: cache identity mismatch; investigate before any further execution

non_claims: L scale is calibration-derived; out-of-range in S2/S3 reported not hidden

execution_binding.binding_note: all hashes computed and frozen at protocol approval time; any code change after freeze invalidates this protocol
